    AI Overview
    Former MLB pitcher Dan Serafini, serving life in prison for the 2021 murder of his father-in-law and attempted murder of his mother-in-law in Lake Tahoe, speaks to Dateline's Keith Morrison in a jailhouse interview. The episode, titled "Deadly Swagger," airs on NBC on April 17, 2026, where Serafini maintains his innocence despite being convicted and sentenced to life without parole. 
    Key Details from the Dateline Special & Case: 
    • Interview Details: Keith Morrison described an "angry" Serafini who was upset about his conviction and criticized the jury and justice system, according to KCRA 3.
    • Case Background: Prosecutors alleged Serafini hired an accomplice to shoot his in-laws, Robert Gary Spohr and Wendy Wood, to access a $23 million inheritance.
    • Guilty Verdict: Serafini was convicted in July 2025 and sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole in February 2026.
    • The Accomplice: Samantha Scott, a family friend, pleaded guilty to accessory after the fact, admitting to driving the getaway car and testifying against Serafini. 
    The Dateline episode also explores the evidence and the shooter’s identity caught on surveillance, as detailed in the Dateline Special Feature.
